message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films you might enjoy:

| # | Title | Year | Director | Why it’s worth watching |
|---|-------|------|----------|------------------------|
| 1 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Stanley Kubrick | A masterclass in psychological terror and atmospheric dread. |
| 2 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Ari Aster | A chilling family drama that escalates into supernatural horror. |
| 3 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Jordan Peele | A smart blend of social commentary and genuine scares. |
| 4 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | John Krasinski | Tension built around silence—perfect for a nerve‑wracking experience. |
| 5 | **The Conjuring** | 2013 | James Wan | A modern supernatural thriller grounded in real‑life paranormal investigations. |
| 6 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Ari Aster | A daylight horror that turns the sunny Swedish festival into a nightmare. |
| 7 | **It Follows** | 2014 | David Robert Mitchell | A unique premise that keeps you on edge with its relentless pacing. |
| 8 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Jennifer Kent | A psychological horror that explores grief and motherhood. |
| 9 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Gore Verbinski | A modern retelling of a Japanese horror classic, with a creepy videotape twist. |
|10 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Drew Goddard | A meta‑take on horror tropes that delivers both laughs and chills. |

Feel free to pick any that match your mood—whether you’re after psychological dread, supernatural thrills, or a fresh twist on the genre!
